cpu_tests.warnings: Two upstream SentencePiece SWIG deprecation warnings

limitations: Full raw corpora contain unsupported characters and therefore fail. Scope exclusions are explicit and retained.

Bhasha has no Devanagari Sindhi; 245 single-author prose records supplement that gap. Those same Sindhi records also occur in the independent run, so corpus totals must not be added as unique examples.
Independent Wikimedia selection may share upstream authorship with public training text. These audits informed character selection and are not an untouched held-out ASR test.
Round-trip failures are counted only on unknown-free records; unknown records already fail coverage.
Text/token preservation and synthetic numerical tests do not establish actual checkpoint compatibility or ASR accuracy.
54 protected probes are English/control examples and existing special/tag strings, not a natural-language corpus for every original locale.
source_file_hash_scope: Historical source hashes from the measurement date. Display paths follow the renamed untok layout; these are not hashes of the current files. The original report is preserved in Git history.

standard_exemplar_audit.scope: CLDR48 standard sets for the exact target scripts; all inheritance resolved.

standard_exemplar_fixes.reason: Missing standard Bengali, Kannada and Telugu exemplar characters exposed by an independent alphabet audit, then added and explicitly retested.
